title: Verify OpenAI/Codex adapter against Pi 0.84.2 and clean review findings

Fixed three P3 findings: removed unexplained terra rank-0 model preference, collapsed dead endpointFor ternary, relaxed pi-ai peer pin to ^0.84.0.
